en: The front image of the postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a town with a prominent church featuring a tall steeple, several houses, a wooden bridge over water, and forested hills in the background. The printed word 'STÖDE.' appears on the bottom left, and publication information 'Förlag: G. Pettersson, Nederede.' is on the lower right. The back shows 'BREFKORT. (Carte postale.)' at the top and is addressed to 'Fru E.C. Strömkvist' in Sundsvall, with clear handwriting in Swedish.
